_doc: Per-character settings for generate.py; see docs/generative-portraits.md. Variant ids are files of the `dune-hd heads` dump: fNN = a frame the game lists, vNN = part group NN drawn over frame 0. method: rerender (default; shapes) or recolour (colours; 'over' = the frame it is drawn over, default the base). kind is a label for people (and for a future openness heuristic).
